about: Synthetic 12-bp ancestral FASTA (record 1 = 'ACgtN-' + '.aTGCA'; a second record that must be ignored) and ten sites covering every branch of the join: uppercase anc == ref, uppercase anc == alt, lowercase third allele, lowercase anc == ref on a bare '21' chromosome name, 'N', '-', '.', a position past the sequence end, a non-SNV row (written, not counted as biallelic) and one row of another chromosome (skipped under chrom='chr21'). expected_rows is the full output table in input order; expected_counts and expected_rates are exact.
